disclosures.name: sample sufficiency (DISCLOSURE, not a pass condition)
disclosures.reading: the direction may be right but the magnitude is not trustworthy; do not quote the point estimate
disclosures.why_not_a_condition: The original threshold was CI width < effect. It is mathematically unreachable on this dataset at any holding period -- 404 years of data at 5 days, 30 years at 60. A rule that can only ever say FAIL trains people to ignore the rules, so it was demoted to a mandatory disclosure. See plan.md R16-Q1 and process.md S-45.

note: passed=None means NOT MEASURED, which is not a pass (plan.md R17). Conditions 1-5 require a validation run; without one the verdict is UNDECIDED, never PASSED.
